Index.title: Bora Bora
Index.subtitle: Semporna Blue Bay Resort
Index.description: This tranquil haven is located in the heart of Semporna, boasting stunning sea views.
Index.scrollDown: Scroll down to awaken more beauty

Intro.tagline: WHERE THE BLUE SKY MEETS THE AZURE SEA
Intro.description: The resort is nestled on a golden sandy beach in the heart of the lagoon, enjoying one of the world's most iconic ocean views. Spacious overwater bungalow suites and beachfront villas create a unique luxury experience for guests, perfectly blending natural beauty with refined service.

beachfront.title: Beachfront Villa with Pool
beachfront.description: Stay in a private oceanview residence with wrap-around terrace and private pool.

overwater.title: Overwater Bungalow Suite
overwater.description: Float above the turquoise lagoon with glass floor panels for underwater viewing.

suite.title: Beachfront Suite
suite.description: Direct beach access to the ocean, enjoying the perfect combination of tranquility and luxury.

Experience.title: Explore Bora Bora, Experience the Extraordinary
Experience.subtitle: From traditional cultural exploration to water sports, discover endless possibilities in Bora Bora

culture.title: HIRO'A TUMU Cultural Adventure
culture.description: Participate in the Hiro'a Tumu cultural adventure program to explore traditional Tahitian culture. Learn weaving, carving, traditional dance, and experience the warmth and wisdom of locals.

wellness.title: Balinese Yoga Wellness
wellness.description: Practice yoga and meditation on the white sand beach with the sound of waves in the morning. Under the guidance of professional instructors, feel the perfect fusion of body, mind, and nature.

diving.title: Ocean Diving Journey
diving.description: Explore magnificent coral reefs with professional instructors. Witness manta rays, sea turtles, and tropical fish swimming freely in the azure waters.

Dining.title: From breakfast to dinner, taste every carefully prepared delicacy
Dining.description: The hotel's four restaurants and bars offer a rich selection of cuisine, from authentic Polynesian flavors to international gourmet dishes, satisfying your discerning palate.
Dining.destination: From Bosphorus Île to Pélangues, explore markets and unique flavors
Dining.atsohadora: ATSOHADORA is the hotel's signature restaurant, offering creative cuisine that combines local ingredients with international culinary techniques.
